identity: SHA-256 of restricted canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII, no NaN or Infinity. Domain and graph identities are computed independently.
invariants: The domain owns exactly one scheduler, its workers and all queue/scratch memory; a second scheduler or worker_count other than one is rejected by this fixture.
Admission validates the graph, format, epoch and assets before allocating per-stream provider state; duplicate graph or provider resources and domains at max_streams reject with zero acceptance.
Each stream has independent provider state, one input submitter, one output consumer, three input and three output frame slots, one processing invocation in flight and at most one output lease.
stream_enqueue copies the frame, records capture/deadline monotonic nanoseconds and never retains a caller pointer; a full input queue rejects with zero acceptance and never discards an older frame.
stream_pull is nonblocking FIFO with NOT_READY while work is outstanding and END_OF_STREAM only after complete drain and an empty output queue; full output queue creates explicit input backpressure.
A lease carries immutable samples, result/source metadata, actual output-ready monotonic time, an opaque lease_id and domain/stream identity; a second pull before release is BUSY.
stream_release returns exactly the named output slot; wrong, duplicate or cross-stream lease IDs are explicit INVALID_ARGUMENT and free nothing.
stream_end_input closes admission and schedules bounded drain after queued work; no synthetic accepted audio is created while flushing.

stream_quiesce runs only on the control thread; policy=drain waits at the barrier while the caller keeps pulling and policy=cancel discards queued and unleased work with interval accounting, or returns a deterministic timeout.
Cancellation of in-flight work waits at the control barrier, discards obsolete-epoch output with a reason and never delivers it to another stream; a lease outstanding at reset/remove returns BUSY.
stream_reset requires no active lease and quiesced state and a strictly greater epoch; it clears queues and provider state and records cancelled old intervals. Empty repeated remove is harmless.
Domain and stream stats are closed, versioned caller-buffer JSON queries using required-size rules; every counter is an exact decimal string and no volatile pointer, path or wall clock enters stats.

Analysis_v1 events are admitted only from the configured producer, tap, signal and calibration with matching epoch and bounded source-sample age; wall-clock recency from an unrelated producer never selects an event.

Transition hooks are used only with declared state semantics and finite history/warm bounds; cheap mode is permitted only for a proven state-preserving update, observe produces full audio without committing state, and unsupported hooks run the full scalar path.

Batch hooks declare max_batch 2 or 4, validate lane state identity/configuration before any lane changes, keep scalar content mapping per lane, report per-lane validity and failure, and include batch wait in measured availability and deadline accounting.
No public v0 header, ABI, descriptor, registry, provider, default behavior or installed package changes; fixed v0 remains 16 kHz mono f32 with 160-sample frames.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; versioned proposal and source-independent deterministic fixture only
